FLYING
TIGERS
DC-8
IMPORTANT
INFORMATION
FLYINGERS
MELINE TIGERS
WELCOME ABOARD!
The Flying Tiger Line has taken every precaution to
ensure your safety during this flight and although we
do not anticipate any emergencies, this short
brochure has been prepared for your benefit. We
would appreciate it if you would take the time to
read this brochure and familiarize yourself with the
safety features on board our aircraft, then sit back,
relax, and enjoy the flight.
-PLEASE DO NOT REMOVE FROM AIRCRAFT-
Hwe Chanay

LIFE RAFT INFLATION
1. OXYGEN MASK LOCATION
Oxygen masks are stored in
a compartment above each
row of passenger seats.
Should oxygen be required,
the compartment door
will open automatically
and oxygen masks will
be presented on the door.
2. USING THE MASK
Should oxygen masks appear,
remain seated. Grasp nearest
mask and remove it from its
holder, at the same time pulling free the cord connect-
ing mask to the compartment. This will permit the
oxygen to flow. Place mask over nose and mouth and
breathe normally. Continue to use oxygen until other.
wise directed by a crew member.
3. ADJUSTING THE
MASK
The oxygen mask has an
adjustable head strap to
provide a comfortable fit.
If mask is too tight, hold mask in position and pull
gently on headband with free hand. If mask is too
loose, pull tabs located where headband connects
to oxygen mask.

EVACUATION ON LAND
Our aircraft is fully equipped with emergency exits
and facilities as illustrated on the diagram.
Placards are at each exit giving directions as to
their use. All doors have escape slides - follow
the directions of your flight crew in their use.
EVACUATION SLIDES
1. A special slide is installed at each of the four (4) Exit Doors (A) for rapid escape to the ground. All crew members know how to use
the slides. Obey their instructions.
2. Additional self-inflating slides are located at the Jet Escape Doors (B).
